steps.text: Isidro!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...Ugh... argh...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: —*cough* *cough*!!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: All hands on deck! I'll take the helm! Pascuala and Weedy, take care of Teach!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: The Inquisition's ship is catching up. Wake up, Isidro! Stand up—

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: What happened to your arm?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: —Tsk. They're catching up again. Elysium! Isidro! Can you still swing a sword?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Mine broke! But I can pummel them with my flag!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...But who would use a flag as a weapon on the battlefield?
Isidro grabs his right arm. The searing pain has not yet subsided.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: My left hand is all I need.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Good—

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Look out! They're loading!
The wind carries the cries from the salt ship behind them.
'—Fire!'

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: We're still not fast enough.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Can we make it into the Skeletal Reef before they catch up?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Even if we can't, I have no intention of stopping.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: But the ship's badly damaged... I only managed to repair part of it. That hit we just took went through half the hold!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: And took all Isidro's alchemy equipment out with it! Without the compass, how are we supposed to get out of Skeletal Reef, even if we make it in?
Isidro can feel the Corazonix pulsating beneath his glove.
He may have lost an arm, but all is not lost.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...There will be a way.
Isidro casts his eyes towards the Skeletal Reef. The bones littering the ground grow larger with every passing moment.
One kilometer.
Turning is no longer an option for La Conquista. Juana grabs the helm wheel with such strength that the wood creaks under the pressure.
She leans forward, eyes fixed dead ahead on the terrifying Skeletal Reef, as though it is her prey.
Five hundred meters.
A sharp grain of salt brushes past her cheek, leaving a mark.
Pascuala squints into the wind and salt, but can only barely see the massive sails approaching from behind.
One hundred meters.
Microorganisms have dyed the bleached bones crimson.
This land had never seen such vivid colors, even before the sea came.
Fifty meters.
Steam gushes through the holes in the bones, powerful and dense.
At their end is a crimson mist the color of blood, spraying into the wind.
Ten meters.
All breaths are held.
La Conquista roars into the valley. Dozens of steam pillars blast out from the skeletons lining the sides of the canyon, filling the space that it occupied mere moments ago.
They tear through sails like paper.
The salt ship following in hot pursuit, a monstrosity dozens of meters in length, is torn to pieces as though a toy.
The mast, dragged down by tattered sails, lies across the gorge, before the steam breaks it too in half, sending the pieces plunging into the salt.
Scraps of wood and bone fly into the air, forming a sharp, deadly rain.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Their ship was destroyed by the steam!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Holy finshit! I'm alive! I'm actually alive!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: It's too early to celebrate.
Salt dust is blown away by the steam, revealing yet another salt ship, trampling the carcass of its brethren beneath its heel as it charges towards them.
The flag of the Inquisition flies high upon its mast, yet it is Anastasio, standing beneath it, whose presence commands more attention.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: They've got guts, I'll give them that.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Let this be their burial ground, then.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Hooks!
Dozens of hooks fly towards La Conquista. Most fall harmlessly into the salt, but a few find the gaps upon her hull.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: La Conquista is heavier than us! Don't try to pull it in, let it drag us towards it!

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Board once we're close enough, and take that ship!
Taut ropes creak as both ships tremble. The sailors draw their weapons, sizing up the distance between the ships.
Suddenly, a spinning helm wheel flies out from the stern of La Conquista, snapping the ropes linking the two ships.
The sharper-eyed sailors recognize it immediately.

steps.name: Frightened Sailor
steps.text: It's Juana!
At that terrified cry, a figure in black leaps from La Conquista and lands on the salt ship.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Have you already forgotten everything I taught you?!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You couldn't hook a bloody saltfin, the way you're tossing those!

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: She wants to take our helm wheel! Stop her!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You fight like a starving saltfin! No, worse!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Hold that cutlass properly! What are you trying to do, cut a steak?!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Don't kill Juana! All we need is the compass!

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Open your damn eyes, Javier!

steps.name: Frightened Sailor
steps.text: She's here to kill us! It's us or her! We gotta kill her for the reward!

steps.name: Howling Sailor
steps.text: I was right all along, Javier! You're just her little pet!

steps.name: Howling Sailor
steps.text: Well, I'm not! I want to live! I want to live good! If you don't want that bounty, I'll take it!
Juana swings her helm wheel into a charging pirate, who falls to the ground in a heap, but the rest keep coming with even greater fury.
Javier is left in the back. He grips his weapon tight, but does not move his feet.
It takes a while before he cries out—

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: I said! Don't kill Juana! All we need is the compass!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: But I'm going to kill YOU, Javier.

steps.name: Howling Sailor
steps.text: Quit giving orders, Javier! Who do you think you are?

steps.name: Howling Sailor
steps.text: Kill Juana! Her head will make us rich!
Just as no one can shake their own shadow, Isidro turns around to see Anastasio standing behind him.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: There you are.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Form up, my brothers! Attack!

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Elysium! Protect the helm with Weedy! Don't let them take control!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Leaf, switch to attack mode!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: How dare you kick away the waterproof boots I gave Thorns! Did you think a communications specialist couldn't fight?

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Stay away from me with that stinking mop of yours!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: It's a FLAG, you scuttlehead! I wash it every week! Or at least try to!

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: You have very nearly killed me twice now, Isidro. A feat none before have accomplished.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Why then do you so earnestly seek my death? What is this desire you have failed to realize because of me? This desire that is so much stronger than anyone else's?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I don't have any desires.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: ...Impossible. All mortals are driven by desire.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Myself first and foremost.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: If you're driven by desire too, then you have no right to kill people in the name of suppressing it... Even if you're with the Inquisition.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: The Inquisition? No. Once, I wished for nothing more than that priest from the Inquisition to kill me and end my sinful life.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: But alas, he denied his own right to judge me, to execute me... and in so doing denied my right to die.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: You still have that right, Isidro. The right to an easy end.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I have no interest in dying.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Maybe so, but you have been tainted by the strongest of all desires, no? Then you have already lost your free will.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: You are compelled to sin. You simply cannot stop yourself.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Why do you hide your broken right arm with that glove?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Those controlled by desire always refuse to admit that their obsession will lead them to ruin.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: You cannot turn back. No one like you can. So I will kill you to stop your sins.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: But before that, you shall first face your desire! Acknowledge it!

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Only by doing so can you die sober and fighting.

Anastasio's sword slices through the air with a piercing shrill, targeting Isidro's right hand. Isidro twists his body at a nearly impossible angle to evade, but the blade's tip still rips through his glove.
Corazonix seeps out of the tear in his glove, turning into delicate ribbons that drift towards every corner of the valley.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...What's going on?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: So that is where you have hidden the compass.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: I have watched over that anathema for so many years, yet not once have seen it respond so eagerly to one's desires.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Such powerful desire, Isidro, yet you do not even know it.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: If you knew the first thing about alchemy, you'd know it doesn't respond to desire. Not mine or anyone else's.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Under the manipulation of an alchemist, Corazonix leaves the compass and enters the natural cycle before returning to the compass. Then the alchemist deciphers the information it brings back.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: That is its basic principle. It has nothing to do with anything as subjective as desire.
Isidro has read too many alchemical tomes and listened to too many of Aulus's lessons. He could recite these principles backward and forward.
But he cannot help but ask himself: Is that really everything there is to the compass, to Corazonix?
Why did the Corazonix on his arm start drifting without any input from him?
Does he not want to know what it is responding to?
Does he not want to know what he wants?
The distraction is enough for Anastasio's sword to pierce his left shoulder.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: —Argh!

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Where is your desire, Isidro? That most powerful desire that compels you to kill me?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Will you die as the puppet of that desire, without even knowing what it is?!

steps.name: Tall Warrior Priest
steps.text: Found her! She's got someone on her back! Get her!

steps.name: Pursuing Warrior Priest
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Can't... run... so... heavy...

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Put me down... Go on without me...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: —Grr!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Pascuala?

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Pascuala!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: You can't run like this! They'll get us both! Drop me and run!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: I'm not letting go!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: You gave me your blanket, your water, and you put me to bed...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: I... I'm not letting go!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We just hit something! The ship's drifting! I can't keep it on course!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Out of the way! Let me handle it!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: How—

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Trust in the Liquid Nitrogen Cannon! But I may not get the output exactly right, so keep your hand on the wheel!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You got it!
Bone swords rattle. Saltfin hide armor clashes. A roaring sailor walks up to Juana.
The other sailors pull their armor off and form a circle of flesh and blood. Inside the circle is Juana, and the sailor who issued the challenge.
Juana is taken aback for an instant, then laughs as she understands.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: So you remember the tradition.

steps.name: Fearless Sailor
steps.text: How could we forget? You taught us how to challenge the leader when we were kids!

steps.name: Fearless Sailor
steps.text: But now your life is worth big money, enough to set me up for life!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: —Come at me then!
Juana swings the helm wheel with a whoosh and slams it into the man's bare chest with a sickeningly dull thud.
His chest collapses, and he falls onto the deck without so much as a gurgle and wheeze.
But the others step over his blood, crying in fury as they rush towards Juana with weapons in hand.

steps.name: Howling Sailor
steps.text: Die!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Roaring Sailor
steps.text: Raaaah!
Yet another sailor charges forward, but hesitates for an instant when his eyes meet Juana's.

His axe slows for a split second, just enough time for Juana's helm wheel to connect first. The last thing he sees is the pale salts filling his eyes, even as the lower half of his body clings to the deck.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: This is no place to be getting cold feet!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: A moment of hesitation is the difference between life and death!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Who's next?
Another sailor steps up through the pool of blood, cutlass in hand. She seems a little thinner and frailer than the others.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Oh... if it isn't little Lomi?

steps.name: Frail Sailor
steps.text: Aye, boss. It's me.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: What do you plan to do with the reward money?

steps.name: Frail Sailor
steps.text: I got a daughter. It's all hers!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Good! Then come and claim what is hers!
The frail sailor gulps and swings her cutlass at Juana, who lands a blow first with a backhand swing.
One of her arms hits the ground, unleashing a spray of blood.
Her other arm, however, continues clenching her cutlass.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Come! Raise your weapon! We're not done yet!

steps.name: Frail Sailor
steps.text: Haah... Ahhh...

steps.name: Frail Sailor
steps.text: Arrrggghhh!!!
Once again, she musters the courage to charge at Juana, but the heavy helm wheel finds her forehead faster.
Suddenly, the frail sailor is pushed aside.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: I'll do it.

steps.name: Frail Sailor
steps.text: ...Thought you didn't want us to kill her?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: No. I'm your leader. At this point, what you want is what I want.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: And as your leader, I'm supposed to protect you, not watch you walk to your deaths one by one.
Javier draws his weapon and wades into the blood.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Your move, Juana.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: *pant* *pant* Urghh—!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: You can put me down here. I'm feeling better. I can fight.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: *pant* *pant* These chupamedias... they're like saltfins who smell blood... can't shake them...

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: You've finally stopped. How many times have you taken what doesn't belong to you, you dirty little thief? You've got nerve to still be talking here.

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: Catch the thief and the bandit! Bring them back to the Inquisition!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: ...'Thief'?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: 'What doesn't belong to me'?
Pascuala picks up a fallen cutlass and charges at the warrior priests before her, red with fury.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Bloodsucking finshit! I could've lived a decent life until you people came after me and threw me out! How dare you assume I've become immoral just because my family has fallen on hard times?!

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: What's she going on about... She's gone mad! Kill her!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: All I wanted that day was to go back home and get what was mine as a kid! I wasn't stealing! My abuela made that bracelet for me!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: What's wrong with taking what is mine? Who do you think you are, branding me a thief, no matter what I did, no matter what I said! I even begged you—

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Begged you to let me find a job in town and live a decent life! But you people called me a thief and kicked me out!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Well, now I'm a thief! Are you happy now? Are you happy?!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Inquisition finshit! You don't get to tell me what belongs to me or not!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Aaaaaaaahhhhhhhh––!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We're flying!!!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Objectively speaking, the ship did, in fact, go airborne for a few seconds. I may have overtuned the LN cannon a tad... But don't worry, I also have a smaller water cannon to help slow it down...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We're going too fast! I can't avoid that bone up ahead! Do something with that cannon of yours!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I don't know if I can knock away a bone as big as that! Brace for impact!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It's not fair... I just fixed the ship!

steps.name: Warrior Priest
steps.text: There's someone here!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Didn't we just get rid of you?!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Alright, I'll deal with them. Weedy, you fix up the ship. Again.
Javier's blade meets the helm wheel with a dull clang that echoes through the valley. He feels his arms going numb.
Hesitantly, he strings a few words together in the gaps between attacks.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Juana... what do you... think you're doing...?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Killing traitors.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: No... Juana!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: If all you wanted was to kill us, you could've done so easily. Why hold to the tradition?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: You're trying to tell us to affirm our decision by facing you with courage?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Am I wrong? AM I WRONG?!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: *pant* *pant* Juana...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Javier...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: If you've realized that, why are you still holding back?
Isidro's left arm is shaking with pain. His sword has already left his hand.
Under Anastasio's incessant interrogation, he finds himself overcome by an even sharper pain.
The dispersed Corazonix once again converges upon him, having drifted amidst the salt and steam.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: You asked what I want.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I want Juana to sail upon the seas that she's longed for all these years.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I want Pascuala to go to bed with a full stomach, not wake up in the middle of the night from hunger.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I want Weedy to go back safely to her research, and for Elysium to make it on time to that concert he's been looking forward to.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Yet all I see is how you people tear each other apart as you hasten to your own demise.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Who, precisely, did this tragedy begin with?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Juana. She, who has forgotten the pain of the Profound Silence. She, who is determined to ride to her doom seeking thrills that live on only in her memory.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: It was her desire that dragged Pascuala into the abyss. The girl who wanted nothing more than food on the table was made to steal the Inquisition's forbidden relic, blinded by greed and promises of riches.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: And then the rest of your fellows. When you say you wish their lives to return to normalcy, have you given any thought as to why they fell to abnormality?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: It was because of you, Isidro.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Juana's desire infected you, and you in turn have infected more innocents.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: People are affected by one another. There's nothing wrong with that.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Everyone I met at Aarón kept their head down and their windows shut. No one spoke a word to each other, unless it was absolutely necessary.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Maybe it's the teachings of the Inquisition, or maybe the trauma of the great calamity that's never faded from their hearts. I couldn't say.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: What I can say, though, is that no one should have to live like that.
Anastasio pulls his sword out of Isidro's shoulder.
Carrying the red glow of the steam, the Corazonix returns to its place inside Isidro's glove and once again flows upon his arm.
For an instant, he can feel the gushing heat of the entire Skeletal Reef converged upon his right arm.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Go on, Isidro. If you have finally decided to expose your true nature, then I shall hear your confession.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Because of my mentor, for a very long time, I thought the ultimate end of human interaction was consumption and assimilation, just like the Seaborn.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I thought I would be consumed by others just as I consumed them. That there would always be people compelled by someone else's desires, held hostage by someone else's decisions, ultimately losing sight of their own selves.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: In the years before I joined Rhodes Island, I did my utmost to avoid something like that happening... like what happened to the people of Aarón.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: But now, I understand that the 'self' I had tried so hard to protect was empty. There was nothing there.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Even after I earned some money, I lived exactly as I had as a vagabond. I wore the same clothes, ate the same food, stayed in the same places, did the same things.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I didn't know what I wanted. Maybe I didn't want anything.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Is it not happiness to live as an empty canvas?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Is that not true freedom?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Unlike your current self, the one forced to drag but more innocent souls into the abyss, as you have done.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Juana gave me a chance to leave. I chose to stay. Neither of us regrets our decisions.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: So, if I indeed dragged Elysium and Weedy into this, then I should give them a chance to leave or stay.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: If you want to kill them, then I'll just have to kill you first.
Isidro senses the once chaotic movement of the Corazonix becoming rhythmic. With each pulse on his arm, steam bursts from the nearby bones.
It dawns on him that the Corazonix, salvaged from the transmutation table, is now fulfilling its intended function while attached to him.
He wants to lead his friends out of this deadly Skeletal Reef, so it is guiding him by indicating the direction of the searing steam flowing through the bones.
Isidro tears his glove off.
Flowing Corazonix has filled every gash and hole that the Arts energy had left upon his flesh.
It is now as one with him.
He picks up his sword with his right arm, and points it at Anastasio's face.
